COND_NATURAL.definition: 값이 자연수(양의 정수)여야 하는 제한이 실제 해 선택 또는 결정적 판정에 영향을 주는 경우.

COND_ODD.definition: 값이 홀수여야 하는 제한이 실제 해 선택 또는 결정적 판정에 영향을 주는 경우.

resolvedOverlapNotes.detail: Audited definition '유리함수 y = k/(x-p)+q의 그래프가 점근선의 교점 (p, q)에 대하여 점대칭이고 직선 y = ±(x-p)+q에 대하여 선대칭인 성질' states the same two symmetry properties as the ACTIVE canonical definition '유리함수 그래프가 두 점근선의 교점 (p, q) 및 기울기 ±1인 직선에 대하여 대칭인 성질'; only the label wording differs. The keys were not merged and the audited definition was not rewritten.
resolvedOverlapNotes.recommendedAction: ROOT adjudication: register the audited new key, or direct reuse of the immutable ACTIVE CC_GRAPH_SYMMETRY_CENTER entry. Registration can proceed with the FUNCTIONS mapping above if distinct-key policy applies.

resolvedOverlapNotes.detail: Audited definition '증가하는 함수 y=f(x)와 역함수 y=f^-1(x)의 교점은 직선 y=x 위에 놓이므로 f(x)=x의 실근으로 귀결되는 성질' states the same claims as the ACTIVE canonical definition '증가하는 함수 y=f(x)와 역함수 y=f^(-1)(x)의 교점이 직선 y=x 위에 존재함을 이용한 방정식 풀이' (intersections lie on y=x and the problem reduces to f(x)=x). The keys were not merged and the audited definition was not rewritten.
resolvedOverlapNotes.recommendedAction: ROOT adjudication: register the audited new key, or direct reuse of the immutable ACTIVE CC_INVERSE_GRAPH_INTERSECTION entry. Registration can proceed with the FUNCTIONS mapping above if distinct-key policy applies.

decisions.rootAdjudication: Keep distinct audited keys additively; no existing key is merged, renamed, redefined or retired. Different-key conceptual overlap is permitted by the user and not a same-key semantic collision.
